page.layout: One page of text in a single column, running down from the top. Running head centred at the top, page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right, gathering signature at bottom centre. Faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored.

main_text.p: Statumen maritandis vitibus, Col. Ulmus maritus, Catul. Virga, pertica, furca, hastile, sudes, calamus in vineis, Virg.
Pedatim, vid. Lente.
Pedatio] Arundulatio, Varr. Subligatio uvarum, Pallad. Ligatura, Id.
Pedes] Pedarius, Cic. Pedaneus, Vlp. Pedestris. Manipularis, Cicer. Commanipularis, Commanipulo, Spart. (Servus.)
Pedestri itinere] Pedes ibat, Virg. Pedibus ire, Cicer. Pedester profectus est, Apul. Incedere pedes, Liv. Metamur gradibus militaribus, Plaut.
Pedetentim, vid. Paulatim.
Pedica, vid. Laqueus.
Pediculosus] Pedicosus, Titin. Pedicularis, Col.
Pediculus] Pes, Varr. Serpens. Animalia capillorum, Plin.
Pedissequa, vid. Ancilla.
Peditatus] Pedites. Pedestres copiae, Cicer. Pedestris acies, Liv. Pedestris militia, Amm. Manipulares, Plin.
Pejerare] Pejerare conceptis verbis, Cicer. Perjurare, Plaut. Perfidum ducere sacramentum, Hor. Perjerare, Lips. Taubm.
Pejor] Deterior, Cic. Sequior fortuna, Amm.
Pejora nancisci] De foece haurire.
Pejùs] Deteriùs scripta, Cicer. Sequiùs, vel seccius, Tacit.
Pellere] Propellere, Repellere, Depellere famem. Fugare, Expellere, Exterminare, Exigere, Cic. Propulsare hostem, Caes. Protelare, Fest. Appellere, Plaut.
Pellere vi] Expellere furcâ, Hor.
Pelles] Pelliceum, vid. Pellicium stragulum, Paul. IC.
Pellex, vid. Concubina.
Pellicere, vid. Illicere.
Pellio] Pellarius, Firm. Bracharius, Lampr.
Pellis] Corium, Salust. Exuviae leonis, Virg. Spolium ferarum, Ovid. Tergus, Virg.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the facing page is present throughout the right half and was not transcribed. Small marks at the left edge are the neighbouring page and were ignored.
